notes: COLD RUN 9073. The club brief a tenth time, unchanged from 9072's so the only new variable is LF 0.107.0. WHAT THIS TESTS: 9072 measured a clean zero AND shipped a package in which occlusion culling hid real geometry -- the walker turned the flag off in a copy and a basement stairwell appeared, along with walls coming and going over 0.7 m. bake_occluders took a module's AABB as a proxy for what it blocks, so a floor plate with a stairwell cut through it emitted a 36 x 13 m box, 2 cm thick, spanning the opening. 0.107.0 measures the uncovered area of every solid module on its thin axis and refuses to emit a box for one over 0.25 m2 -- derived: the smallest opening this pipeline cuts is a 1.43 m2 ladder hole and the measured uncovered area of all 381 modules without an opening was exactly 0.000000 m2. On 9072's package that drops 11 of 392 occluders, retains 65.3% of the occlusion benefit and restores 5,746 object-frames. WHAT WOULD FALSIFY THE CLAIM: an export refused by the new gate, an occluders report whose rows lack uncovered_m2, a holed count of 0 on a package with stair openings, or a walk that still shows geometry appearing when occlusion is turned off. A gate that passes is not the same as a level that reads right.
